paragraphs: Citizenserve sells cloud software for community development, pulling permitting, inspections, code enforcement, planning and zoning, and licensing into a single system. Its buyers range from small towns and growing cities to large counties, departments inside major cities, and specialized agencies.

The company says the platform matches an agency's existing workflows without custom coding. It connects to GIS and financial systems among others. Applications, processing, and tracking sit in one secure system that the company says runs at 99.999% uptime. The licensing side covers online applications, automated renewals, payments, contractor tracking, and compliance. A published case describes work with Lawrence, Massachusetts to create a dedicated food permit type and a custom food establishment inspection form. On completion, the system generates an inspection report formatted for state submission.

The company says many of its clients have stayed with it for over twenty years. It reports that 99% of users give its support team a thumbs up. It also claims 99.999% uptime and zero data losses over more than 20 years.
